name: Kickloop
summary: A sneaker shop page where six shoes ride a turning wheel you can drag, spin and snap
about: A product carousel page for a shoe shop, fashion brand or any product with several colours. Six sneakers sit around a big half-hidden wheel: drag or swipe it and it keeps spinning, then snaps the nearest shoe to the top, where it grows and tilts while the whole hero wipes to that shoe's colour. Pick a size, add the pair to a cart drawer, and scroll on to an exploded sole, a draggable lookbook and reviews.
how: The wheel spins in fast and lands on the first sneaker while the name letters slam into place
Drag or swipe the wheel; let go and it keeps turning with momentum, then springs the nearest sneaker to the top
Use the arrows, the arrow keys or the colour dots to turn straight to a sneaker; the background wipes to its colour and the price counts to the new one
Pick an EU size (sold-out sizes are crossed out) and press Add to cart: the shoe flies into the cart and the count updates
Open the cart to change pairs, see the free-delivery bar fill and run a simulated checkout
Scroll to watch the sole split into its three layers, drag through the lookbook and see the review bars fill
